proposal.root_cause: Commit 3012ed958ccd4f5fc3ce7f740d8f6ec94faf35b5 lowered the api-b container memory limit to 32Mi (request 24Mi), causing the container to be OOMKilled (exit 137) and the pod to CrashLoopBackOff.
proposal.rationale: Pod api-b-7c9fb9b5c8-86w2l in demo-b is in CrashLoopBackOff; the container's lastState shows exitCode 137 / reason OOMKilled (memory limit 32Mi). The most recent commit touching the workload, 3012ed958ccd4f5fc3ce7f740d8f6ec94faf35b5 ("chore(demo-b): update api-b.yaml"), reduced resources from requests 96Mi / limits 128Mi down to requests 24Mi / limits 32Mi — exactly matching the pod spec. The prior commit 372eda64ac40b961dde37859f9e02927c86e2bbe established 96Mi/128Mi as the working values. Restoring those values is the minimal, history-grounded fix.
proposal.verify: After merge and Argo CD sync, the new ReplicaSet should run with limits.memory=128Mi/requests.memory=96Mi; pod api-b should become Ready, restartCount stops increasing, and no further OOMKilled (exit 137) events appear in demo-b.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api-b
  namespace: demo-b
  labels:
    app: api-b
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo-b/api-b.yaml
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api-b
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api-b
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api-b
          image: python:3.12-alpine
          command: ["python", "/app/app.py"]
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8000
          env:
            - name: APP_VERSION
              value: "1.0.0"
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: api-b-config
          volumeMounts:
            - name: code
              mountPath: /app
              readOnly: true
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8000
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8000
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: 24Mi
              cpu: 50m
            limits:
              memory: 32Mi
              cpu: 500m
      volumes:
        - name: code
          configMap:
            name: api-b-code
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: api-b
  namespace: demo-b
  labels:
    app: api-b
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo-b/api-b.yaml
spec:
  selector:
    app: api-b
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 8000
      targetPort: 8000

  "name": "api-b",
  "status": "replicas=1 ready=1 available=1"

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api-b
  namespace: demo-b
  labels:
    app: api-b
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo-b/api-b.yaml
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api-b
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api-b
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api-b
          image: python:3.12-alpine
          command: ["python", "/app/app.py"]
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8000
          env:
            - name: APP_VERSION
              value: "1.0.0"
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: api-b-config
          volumeMounts:
            - name: code
              mountPath: /app
              readOnly: true
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8000
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8000
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: 24Mi
              cpu: 50m
            limits:
              memory: 32Mi
              cpu: 500m
      volumes:
        - name: code
          configMap:
            name: api-b-code
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: api-b
  namespace: demo-b
  labels:
    app: api-b
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo-b/api-b.yaml
spec:
  selector:
    app: api-b
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 8000
      targetPort: 8000
